fields.name: Airflow_Instructions
fields.fieldText:
Airflow: Use appropriate chart for booth model. Using an anemometer, measure at all the points indicated and record results. Balanced air differential should be no greater than 20 ft/min from one side to the other. Recommended average balanced velocity for refinish applications is 50-80 FPM. Booth should be loaded with an average mid-sized sedan. Only one box that's associated with the booth model below needs to be completed.

For Downdraft booths, please use the boxed diagram. For Semi-downdraft or Side-downdraft booths, please use the Ford car diagram.
